reason: I like that the label is just water, mate and fruit with no sweeteners, that's what I look for. But 55 CZK a can is a lot when a Monster Ultra at the petrol station is cheaper and a thermos of coffee costs me almost nothing on a night shift.
objection: Why pay 55 crowns for a can when coffee or water does the job, and I can't even grab it at the petrol station or shop where I actually am at 4am, only from an e-shop or a café.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at petrol stations or Albert for around 35-40 CZK, so I could swap it for my Ultra on shift.
